current_environment_assessment.agent_role_overlap: The active coding agent currently possesses read/write access to the repository, prompt contracts, and test fixtures.
current_environment_assessment.mandatory_policy: A single agent session cannot truthfully attest to independent holdout custody. Any claim of achieving sealed qualification in this session is formally prohibited.

required_custody_remediation: Holdout authoring must be performed in an external, isolated repository or by an independent human author.
Sealed truth manifests must be held by an independent third-party custodian with access tokens withheld from the executing agent.
Truth reveals must occur strictly post-execution via cryptographic commitment verification.
